Comprehensive Storage Solutions for Your Vessels

Our Premier Boat and Caravan Storage Services

Discover a range of secure and flexible storage options tailored for all your boating and caravanning needs.

Secure Boat Storage

We offer secure storage for yachts, launches, and trailer boats weighing up to 24 tonnes, ensuring peace of mind for boat owners.

Safe and reliable storage for various types of vessels.

Convenient Slipway Access

Our slipway facilities provide an efficient way to launch and retrieve your smaller vessels with ease, ensuring a hassle-free experience.

Easily launch smaller boats with our onsite slipway.

Ready to Secure Your Boat?

Get Started

Flexible Storage Options

Choose from flexible storage arrangements for both short-term and long-term requirements, designed to accommodate your specific boating schedules.

Short and long-term storage solutions to suit your needs.

Custom Storage Plans

We work with you to create customized storage solutions, ensuring that your vessels are stored safely and conveniently according to your preferences.

Tailored storage plans that fit your unique needs.

Don’t Wait! Secure Your Space Now.

West Auckland Storage is dedicated to providing safe and reliable storage for your boats and caravans in a convenient location.

Get Started
